newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: VMC SOARS 20 PCT ON REHABILITATION NEWS.
newsitem.headline: VMC SOARS 20 PCT ON REHABILITATION NEWS.

text.p: Victorias Milling Corp surged by 20 percent to 2.26 pesos pesos by midtrade on Monday after news the Securities and Exchange Commission had approved the appointment of a committee to rehabilitate the firm, traders said.
"Investors welcomed news of the SEC's intervention in Victorias to enable the firm to regain back its sweetness," said Henry Ong, research head at Sapphire Securities.

On Friday, the SEC granted the petition of the financially troubled sugar miller Victorias to form a committee with representatives from its creditors and the SEC to oversee its rehabilitation and operation.
Under the rehabilitation plan, Victorias will upgrade its facilities over the next five years, sell its non-essential assets and seek new investors to infuse fresh money into the company.
Victorias was one of the oldest and biggest sugar mills in the country.
The SEC ordered recently a moratorium from its debt payments worth 5.07 billion pesos.
Victorias suffered years of losses due to a slump in the local sugar industry, traders said.
Some 703,000 Victorias shares changed hands as of 10:42 a.m. local time (0242 GMT).
